outline: 認識高頻電子電路動作原理並建立高頻電子電路設計能力，1.傳輸線原理，2.高頻元件，3.散射參數，4.史密斯圖應用，5.小信號放大器，6.低雜訊放大器，7.雜訊分析，8.振盪器，9.混波與檢波，10.鎖相迴路。
schedule:
1. Overview of the course (lec_1)
2. Transmission line (lec_2)
3. Reflection coefficient, smith chart, passive components (lec_3)
4. Filter design (lec_4)
5. Scattering parameters and impedance Transformers (lec_5)
6. Small signal amplifier (lec_6, lec_7)
7. Noise and noise modeling (lec_8)
8. Low noise amplifier (lec_9)
9. Mixer and RF front-end design (lec_10, lec_11)
10. Midterm exam
11. Voltage Controlled oscillator (lec_12)
12. Phase noise in a voltage controlled oscillator (lec_13)
13. Phase locked loop (lec_14, lec_15)
14. Project Report (lec_16, lec_17)
assessment:
1. Attendance -- 20%
2. Midterm (Handout contents) -- 40%
3. Final project (Wireless receiver design) -- 40%
Regarding the final project:
One or two members of a group are allowed.
A wireless receiver including its system specification and circuit design. A proposal report, an oral presentation, and a complete report are required.
